text: This week, Ariel Venus Hooper's (AVH0566) Systems Engineering team triggered a detection rule due to an unusual volume of logons outside their working hours. Specifically, AVH0566 had 4 logons outside their typical hours, which is significantly above their recent range and the highest in the past 12 weeks. This anomaly suggests that AVH0566 may have been actively engaged with systems or data outside their usual work schedule.
